instruction: Look up names similar to Olivia

metadata.explanation: Task variation that asks to find similar names to Olivia. Uses pattern matching to verify navigation to Olivia's name details page. Pattern matches URLs starting with 'https://www.babycenter.com/baby-names/details/olivia-' regardless of the specific ID.
metadata.verification_notes: Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric for robust URL checking without needing exact name IDs.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Semantic mismatch between instruction and verification logic
Instruction asks to 'Look up names similar to Olivia' (find related names like Olive, Oliviana, Livia, etc.)
Evaluator checks if user navigated to Olivia's OWN name details page (https://www.babycenter.com/baby-names/details/olivia-*)
The evaluator does NOT verify that the user found names SIMILAR TO Olivia - it only verifies navigation to Olivia's page itself
This is a fundamental semantic error: the task requires finding related/similar names, but the evaluator checks if the user went to the source name's page
Getter logic is correct: active_url_from_accessTree can extract the active tab URL
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match can perform regex pattern matching
But the expected pattern verifies the WRONG outcome for this instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Option 1: Change the instruction to match the evaluator - 'Look up information about the name Olivia' or 'Navigate to Olivia's name details page'
Option 2: Change the evaluator to verify that the user found similar names - check for URLs containing 'similar', 'related', or other name pages
Option 3: Use HTML content parsing to verify that similar names are displayed on the page (e.g., check for names like Olive, Oliviana, Livia in the page content)
Option 4: Verify navigation to multiple name detail pages that are similar to Olivia, not just Olivia's own page
The current evaluator cannot verify the instruction as written - it only checks if the user went to Olivia's page, not if they found similar names
